title: Central disk sweep 2026-11-14: remove served worktrees of idle/retired sessions (11519, 7422, 11466, 14549, 11465, 8582, 12415, 11865)
outcome: Central's C: drive has room again for builds and full runs. Every served, clean worktree of the listed idle or retired sessions is removed without --force. Worktrees that can't be removed safely keep their source and lose only target\, and they are listed. Nothing in .evidence or .logs is touched.
acceptance: Per root, the record gives the path, HEAD, why it qualified (clean, reachable commit, not a named root, inside .tmp, owner session idle or gone) and the action taken; roots kept or only target-cleaned are listed with the reason.
The total freed is reported from the disk-free readings before and after, and sent to Fable2.
